<function name="Get3DEnabled" parent="IGModAudioChannel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns if the sound channel is currently in 3D mode or not. This value will be affected by <page>IGModAudioChannel:Set3DEnabled</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2020.04.29</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is currently 3D or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
